name: Hugh Brinson Gas Pipeline / Abilene Laterals (Oracle Stargate campus)

values.EndLocation: Oracle Stargate data center campus, Abilene

researcher_notes: Energy Transfer is building three gas laterals off its North Texas system, fed by the Hugh Brinson Pipeline, to supply the Oracle and OpenAI Stargate data center campus at Abilene, Texas. The August 2026 EIA pipeline projects release (Natural Gas Pipeline Projects sheet, Excel row 94) lists them as one project, 'Oracle Data Center Laterals (Hugh Brinson / North Texas)', intrastate Texas, up to 900 MMcf/d, status part completed, first lateral in service June 13, 2026, two more targeted mid-2026. It names the Oracle Abilene campus, which supports the data center tag. The Energy Transfer second quarter 2026 earnings release (an SEC filing) says another 14-mile lateral off the Hugh Brinson Pipeline in Abilene was completed and is ready for service. That release does not name the campus or give a combined length. Not an existing row: the roster has Hugh Brinson (P3885, Odessa to Fort Worth) but no Abilene laterals. Staged as one row because EIA tracks the three as one project and only one length (14 miles) is public. A person may prefer one row per lateral once lengths for the other two are found. Length is left blank: 14 miles is for one lateral only. Not found: the lateral routes, diameters, or a Texas Railroad Commission T-4 document text (EIA cites permit T4-10370). A Natural Gas Intelligence article from February 2026 and an Energy News Beat article were also in the lead list; the first returned an access block and the second did not mention the laterals, so neither is cited. Status is set to operating because at least one lateral is in service; the other two may still be under construction. Confidence is medium: the EIA figures come from an investor presentation, and the second source does not name the campus. Staged in the parent system and project shape under the Hugh Brinson Gas Pipeline, because the Energy Transfer release describes the lateral as off the Hugh Brinson Pipeline. This is a new row of its own, not a change to P3885.
